observations: Enabling ENABLE_BETA=1 at RIDGE_LAMBDA=0 did AVOID the exact EXP-005 cholesky crash but STILL failed the closed-form Phase-2 update, so HYP-T2 (does beta close the MT-acquisition gap without hurting QA) remains UNANSWERED -- no eval ran. beta was genuinely engaged (config enable_beta:true; saved cache-after-doc-002 carries attention_bias_enabled=True with non-zero trainable_beta on all 36 layers, max|beta_logweight|=68.45, mean=4.23, ~19.4% nonzero -- essentially identical to EXP-005's 66.6/4.23/19.4%, since beta_fit_scope=selected touches only top-T slots). The lambda=0 path DID take the robust OLS branch as intended: with RIDGE_LAMBDA=0, effective_ridge_lambda short-circuits to 0.0 (core.py L144-145), so _ridge_lstsq enters the lam==0 gels branch (torch.linalg.lstsq driver='gels', L196-197) NOT the cholesky solve. The failure this time is a DIFFERENT symptom of the SAME root cause: the crash is RuntimeError('NaNs in ridge lstsq solution') at core.py:230 (the explicit post-solve NaN guard), reached from value_solve.py:247 guarded_sparse_am_value_update(attention_bias=head_beta) <- finetune.py:546, NOT the linalg.cholesky positive-definite error at core.py:225 that killed EXP-005. Mechanism: the very large fitted beta log-weights (|beta| up to ~68) are added to the attention logits pre-softmax, collapsing the softmax attention onto near-one-hot and making the value-solve design matrix X rank-deficient; gels assumes full column rank, so on the singular X it returns NaNs rather than raising, and the driver's NaN check then raises. Crash occurred on document index 3 with docs 0/1/2 written successfully (cache-after-doc-000..002 + cache-step1..3 saved) -- the exact same document boundary as EXP-005, indicating a deterministic beta-collapse failure at that doc, not a random numerical fluke. Because the crash preceded the aggregate/eval stage, NO phase2_summary.json was written and neither QA-forgetting nor MT-acquisition eval ran; qa_forgetting_loss and mt_acquisition_loss are null (not fabricated), as are solve_s (no summary wall_clock) and value_global_max_abs. Cost: phase2_e2e_s=294s wall (cold model load + flex_attention autotune/compile + 3 docs + crash) on flock-claimed GPU1; gpu_s unavailable (AM shell starts no monitor; nvidia-smi flaky); gradient_steps=0. Caveat: this is a numerical-stability failure of the beta/NNLS mass-bias path (large fitted biases collapsing X), independent of the ridge solver branch -- the lambda=0 gels path fixed the cholesky symptom but not the underlying rank-deficiency, so beta cannot be exercised end-to-end under the current beta-fitting/attention-bias formulation without a further change.
